title: Arvell Shaw's call and rejoining Armstrong
summary: Louis played 'Some Day' for him, and Arvell Shaw called when Trummy Young left.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well, listen, Chief, between the time you did that Indian school tour and the time you joined Louis Armstrong the second time, what kinds of things did you do? Did you have your own group or did you do a lot of sitting in in New York or did you do a lot of -- Okay, so during the early 60s you were playing around with a lot of musicians as we mentioned before. You played with Punch Miller and with Eddie Condon and some of the other musicians on the scene.
You want me to talk about the second thing with Armstrong?
Yeah, how did you -- your second time, how did that happen? How did that come about?

Well, whenever Louie went to New York, I'd always go to see him and there was a song that he played that he wrote called, 'Some Day.' And Louie knew that I loved 'Some Day,' and every time I'd go to where he was playing, he'd always tell the

musicians, "There's the old Chief. Let's play Some Day" for the old Chief." And he played "Some Day." At that time Trummy Young was with him. This is a few months later that I get a call from Arvell Shaw who was with Louie and, "Chief, Chief," so he said, "Go to Glaser, they want you in the band!" I said, "Oh, they do, how wonderful, that's nice." "Go to see Joe Glaser." I said, "What about Trummy, isn't he with you any more." He said, "Trummy is in Hawaii, he left for Hawaii, he wants to go home. He didn't give us a notice," and this and that. "So I was thinking about the time that I put in the band during the early years, Arvell." So I think Arvell senses that -- he kind of spoke up for me, "Let's get Chief."

And at a later time I heard that that they were after Vic Dickenson, too. But Joe Glaser said, "No, no, no, I don't want Vic Dickenson, he got no personality. Get me Chief. Get me Chief." So Arvell decided he would call me and get in touch with me.
